title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: Sunday, August 23, 2026 - Market Closed (Reporting on Friday, August 21, 2026 Session)

items.headline: U.S. Stocks Rebound to Close Out Shaky Week
items.summary: U.S. stocks saw broad gains on Friday, August 21, 2026, as major indices trimmed their weekly losses. A strong earnings report from Ross Stores and positive U.S. business activity data bolstered investor confidence, despite a volatile bond market. Oil prices also climbed during the session.

items.headline: Ross Stores Surges on Strong Earnings
items.summary: Ross Stores ($ROST) rallied after the discount retailer reported stronger profits for the latest quarter than analysts had expected, driving significant market interest.

items.headline: TG Therapeutics Jumps on Takeover Speculation
items.summary: Shares of TG Therapeutics ($TGTX) surged amid renewed speculation of a potential takeover, with traders citing an 'uncooked' alert suggesting acquisition interest.

items.headline: Robinhood Rises with Bitcoin Rebound
items.summary: Robinhood Markets ($HOOD), a crypto-linked stock, saw gains as Bitcoin (BTC-USD) rebounded to around $77,000, signaling a broader rally in the cryptocurrency market.

items.headline: Coterra Energy Drops in Premarket Trading
items.summary: Coterra Energy Inc. ($CTRA) experienced a notable decline in Friday's pre-market session, making it one of the worst performers.

items.headline: Strong U.S. Business Activity Boosts Corporate Profit Hopes
items.summary: A report indicating strong growth in U.S. business activity fueled optimism for future corporate profits, contributing to positive market sentiment.

items.headline: Jumpy Bond Market Adds Pressure Despite Equity Gains
items.summary: The bond market remained volatile, with U.S. Treasury yields moving higher following stronger-than-expected economic data, including resilient retail sales and a stable labor market.

items.headline: FOMC Minutes Hint at Higher Rates if Inflation Persists
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) revealed that Fed officials are considering the potential for higher interest rates should inflation not cool down as expected.

items.headline: Healthcare and Energy Lead Weekly Sector Performance
items.summary: For the week ending August 21, 2026, the healthcare sector notably outperformed, rising 4.19%, followed by energy, which gained 2.39%. Conversely, industrials and utilities lagged, falling 4.23% and 3.65% respectively.

items.headline: Treasury Announces Doubling of Longer-Dated Securities Buybacks
items.summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent indicated that the Treasury intends to at least double its buybacks of longer-dated Treasury securities, a move aimed at influencing bond market dynamics.
